query: select pl_name,pl_rade,pl_radelim,pl_rade_reflink from pscomppars where pl_controv_flag=0 and sy_snum=1 and cb_flag=0 and hostname in (select hostname from pscomppars where sy_dist<=100 and ra is not null and dec is not null) order by pl_name
caveats: Composite radii may be literature values or archive-calculated estimates; this snapshot does not establish measurement precision. Original parameter references are preserved.
